Counsel for Applicant :- Vijay Kumar,Akhilesh Kumar Mishra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. The FIR in question was lodged alleging that the daughter of the informant was married to the applicant.
It was also stated that she was enticed by the applicant and was married at around 4 years ago.
The said marriage was a love marriage.
It was also alleged that on account of non-payment of dowry, the daughter of the informant committed suicide.
The postmortem report indicates that the cause of death is due to antemortem hanging and ligature mark are present on the neck.

entities.text: Abhijeet Rawat vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The Counsel for the applicant argues that no injury was visible on the body in question.

He further argues that there is no other evidence except the statement of the informant with regard to the demand of dowry and here absolutely no material on record to demonstrate that immediately prior to the death, there is allegation of demand of dowry, which is a sine qua non for attracting punishment under Section 304B IPC.
It is argued that the marriage is a love marriage and there is no chance of demand of dowry.
The applicant is in custody since 19.02.2023 and has no criminal antecedents.
4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the material on record and prima facie that no material to indicate as to whether any demand of dowry was made immediately or in close proximity prior to the death of the deceased coupled with the fact that the applicant is in custody since 19.02.2023 and has no criminal antecedents, there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
6.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Abhijeet Rawat be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.0042 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Bakshi Ka Talab, District Lucknow on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
